zh-CN.title: 设置操作更加统一
items: 菜单、聊天详情和管理面板采用统一的设置行与分组结构
开关、下级入口、当前值和锁定状态现在拥有一致的排版
可在语言与个性化中选择是否展示自己发送消息旁的头像

en.title: A more consistent settings experience
items: Menu, chat details, and admin settings now share one row and group structure
Toggles, navigation, values, and locked states now follow consistent layout rules
Choose whether your avatar appears beside messages you send
